name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the reviewer-ordered diff, and a badge on a line opens its finding
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the Smart Diff (L03) groups the seeded nine files by role: the 'Core logic' header is present, so is a core file (src/middleware/ratelimit.ts) and the lock file (package-lock.json) the classifier must put in Boilerplate. Then click the severity badge on that core file's flagged line and land on the Findings tab with the finding's card open — Round 2's cross-tab journey, the one thing here no component test can prove, because it crosses the route's query state. Exercises useSmartDiff → SmartDiffViewer → FileCard → CodeLine over GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff, which makes no model call, then page.tsx → FindingsTab → ReviewRunAccordion → FindingsPanel → FindingCard over the SEEDED review. Read-only seeded data; the badge's accessible name and both asserted strings are seed literals (server/src/db/seed.ts). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
